risks.suggestion: Replace the brand text and byline copy with the site owner's name across all four pages, then re-check every page for remaining mentions.

risks.title: All four HTML title elements contain identical text
risks.explanation: index.html, about.html, contact.html and post.html each declare the same title string, so the four titles are not distinct as required.
risks.suggestion: Give each page a distinct title reflecting its content.

risks.title: Contact page copy lacks 30-day retention and deletion-on-request statement
risks.explanation: The contact page main copy only invites visitors to fill in the form; it contains no wording about a 30-day retention period or deletion on request.
risks.suggestion: Add static privacy copy stating the 30-day retention period and that data is deleted on request, then re-read the whole contact page.
